description: This script performs stress testing on various cryptographic functions and components of OpenSSL, including UI, BIO, DSA, TLS, cipher, ASN1, DH, HMAC, EVP, X509, EC, BN, RSA, DES, ENGINE, and ERR tests. It manages test execution, system metrics collection, and logs results.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command multiple times in parallel, redirecting output to /dev/null.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script basename to the log file.

methods.name: stress_des_function
methods.description: Runs DES mode internal and DES tests.

methods.name: stress_cipher_function
methods.description: Runs cipher name, list, and byte tests.

methods.name: stress_err_function
methods.description: Runs error and fatal error tests.

methods.name: execute_ui_test
methods.description: Performs UI stress testing with timing and system metrics collection.

methods.name: execute_bio_test
methods.description: Performs BIO stress testing with timing and system metrics collection.

methods.name: execute_dsa_test
methods.description: Performs DSA stress testing with timing and system metrics collection.

methods.name: execute_tls_test
methods.description: Performs TLS stress testing with timing and system metrics collection.

methods.name: execute_cipher_test
methods.description: Performs cipher tests with timing and system metrics collection.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test suite, manages the sequence of all tests, logs start and end times, and collects overall duration.
